input.body:
Dear Student Finance Office,

Kinwarden is acting on behalf of the family of [PERSON_2] (Student ID [STUDENT_ID_1]), who we understand has been admitted to the MSc programme starting January 2027. We will be handling the payment of her fees from China on the family's behalf.

To proceed, could you please send us in one reply:

1. Confirmation that [PERSON_2] (Student ID [STUDENT_ID_1]) is an admitted student on the MSc programme starting January 2027, together with the offer/admission reference.
2. A fee statement or invoice covering the first tuition instalment and the accommodation fee, showing the amount due in each case, the currency, any deposit already received, and the payment deadline for each.
3. The university's bank details on official university letterhead (account name, account number, SWIFT/BIC and bank name) for payments from overseas.
4. Confirmation of the payment reference your bank requires so the money is allocated to her account — we understand this is the Student ID.

If any part of the above (for example a final statement after enrolment) will only be available later, please let us know when to expect it and we will wait for it rather than chase.

Thank you for your help.

Kind regards,
Kinwarden
On behalf of the family of [PERSON_2]
